messages:
jordan_support: FYI - customer acme-inc flagged the token cost dashboard showing $0 and NaN for yesterday's usage. They say billing looks wrong on org page. Screenshot attached in thread.
alex_w: Do we have any alerts on the nightly billing-aggregator job? :thinking:
maya_k: Not seeing a job failure in PagerDuty. Scheduler logs show successful run at 03:10 UTC. But the dashboard query returns 0 for several org_ids.
samir_r: Can you paste the raw query the frontend is using? I want to reproduce locally.
jordan_support: Frontend hits /internal/metrics/org/{org_id}/token_costs with params: start=2026-03-15&end=2026-03-16&granularity=day
jordan_support: Customer provided sample org_id: org_0acme
alex_w: I ran a quick curl against the internal endpoint for org_0acme: ``curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN" "https://internal.redwood/api/internal/metrics/org/org_0acme/token_costs?start=2026-03-15&end=2026-03-16" | jq .``
alex_w: Result: ``{"total_tokens": null, "cost_usd": NaN, "by_day": [{"date":"2026-03-15","cost_usd":0},{"date":"2026-03-16","cost_usd":0}]}" 
maya_k: Null + NaN looks like aggregator returned malformed values. Two hypotheses: 1) a divide-by-zero or missing pricing row during aggregation; 2) downstream serialization converting null to NaN.
samir_r: I pulled the billing-aggregator log for that run. There's a warning at 03:09:58: ``WARN compute_costs: missing pricing for plan_id=null for org=org_0acme, skipping pricing lookup`` then later ``ERROR compute_costs: result for org_0acme contains inf/NaN``
eng-oncall: Paging eng-infra and data-team. @eng-oncall setting ticket to P1 for potential billing impact.
jordan_support: Customer is concerned their monthly invoice will show $0; they're holding product release until resolved.
alex_w: Quick repro steps I used:
```
# reproduce locally (dev cluster)
export INT_TOKEN=... 
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN" \
  "https://internal.redwood/api/internal/metrics/org/org_0acme/token_costs?start=2026-03-15&end=2026-03-16" | jq .
```
Expected: cost_usd numeric; Actual: NaN/null
```
maya_k: Root cause looks like a legacy trial org that never had a plan_id assigned. The aggregator expects plan pricing to compute unit cost; missing plan_id => divisor zero path in cost calc.
samir_r: Patch idea: update compute_costs to fallback to default_pricing_rate when plan_id is null and sanitize NaN -> 0 before serializing. Also emit audit row to billing_audit table.
alex_w: For urgent mitigation, we can re-run billing-aggregator for affected orgs with a forced default_pricing_rate override. I'll prepare a one-off job.
eng-oncall: Do not run wide reprocessing without signoff from data-team. We'll run targeted reprocess for listed org_ids only.
jordan_support: Customer asked for ETA. Can we give an interim fix timeline?
maya_k: Target: hotfix to aggregator sanitization in next 2h, run targeted reprocess in 4h, and update dashboard to show fallback "—" instead of NaN in UI within 8h. I'll handle PR for backend sanitization.
alex_w: Query to find impacted orgs:
```
SELECT org_id FROM billing_raw_usage u
LEFT JOIN orgs o USING (org_id)
WHERE o.plan_id IS NULL
  AND u.event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY org_id;
```
samir_r: Added a filter to the one-off reprocess: limit to orgs returned by query above. Will run in staging for validation.
jordan_support: I offered customer a manual invoice review and temporary note we'll correct dashboard values. They asked to be cc'd on confirmation.
eng-oncall: Postmortem action items:
- data-team: add defensive checks in compute_costs (sanitize NaN/null) (owner: maya_k)
- infra: add integration test for missing plan_id (owner: samir_r)
- frontend: display human-friendly fallback for NaN (owner: alex_w)
- support: notify affected customers after reprocess (owner: jordan_support)
maya_k: Creating PR now: "billing-aggregator: default pricing fallback + sanitize numeric outputs". Linking here when ready.
alex_w: Small UX note: also add a tooltip explaining "zero" vs "no data" to reduce confusion.
jordan_support: Thanks team. I'll update customer with ETA and ask them to hold off on invoice disputes until we reprocess.
billing-bot: Automated note: Ticket #INC-2026-340 created and linked to this thread.
samir_r: After validating staging results, ran targeted reprocess for org_0acme. Staging endpoint now returns cost_usd: 14.27. Will schedule prod run after PR merged and code approved.
maya_k: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/712 (contains unit tests + migration to write audit rows).
eng-oncall: Closing loop: keep thread updated with prod run ID and timestamps. :white_check_mark:
